{"text":"MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The SanDisk card fits my repeated use of memory cards and adapters; spare storage for my tablet or compatible camera equipment is a familiar, practical purchase.",
    "The USB hub and extension cables would make my card reader and other accessories easier to connect and reach, which fits how I build out my existing equipment.",
    "The Fire TV Stick offers a plausible new way to use my TV alongside my DVD player, although 4K adds no benefit to my 720p screen."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The Echo devices assume I want voice control or a dedicated video-calling screen, but neither solves a need reflected in my purchases.",
    "The Blink bundle treats my photography accessories as interest in home surveillance, even though those serve different purposes.",
    "Buying cables does not mean I need six one-foot Ethernet cables; the connector, length, and specific job matter. Wireless earbuds likewise do not support my current storage and accessory needs.",
    "The larger Fire tablet interests me because I own a Fire 7, but that does not mean I am ready to replace it."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Owning a Fire tablet seems to have been taken as interest in a broader collection of Amazon smart devices.",
    "My frequent electronics purchases seem to have been treated as general demand for more gadgets, when many purchases support equipment I already use."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My repeated purchases of memory cards, adapters, storage cases, and a card reader show an ongoing need to store, transfer, and organize data.",
    "My accessory choices depend on compatibility and practical details, such as card format, connector type, cable length, and the device being supported.",
    "I interact frequently, but interest in a newer device does not necessarily mean I need an upgrade now."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognize my practical accessory needs but stretch my existing device ownership into unsupported interest in smart-home gadgets and upgrades."
}"}
